description:
Get all the mailboxFolder objects in the specified mailbox, including any search folders.

TIP: Lists mailbox folders for an Exchange mailbox (admin). Returns id, displayName, totalItemCount, unreadItemCount, childFolderCount, parentFolderId.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-exchange-mailbox-folders
